svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut nine 2,110 mm lengths (the full wall width). Treat them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nail a 25 x 25 mm cleat along each side at the bottom edge, full

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: length; the two end joists get one cleat, on the inner side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On the two joists either side of the fan box, stop the cleat

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 320 mm each side of the joist's mid-point (shown here).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Joist centres along the store, from its centre: 0, 410, 820,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1,180 and 1,480 mm each way. The fan box goes between the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: joists at 820 and 1,180 mm toward the door: 310 mm clear.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each joist bears on the full wall top; one galvanized strap

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: per end, built into the brickwork, nailed to the joist.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: tops in line within 5 mm; the fan bay is 310 mm clear.
